content.text: do you have my take home assignment pdf?

I found [Zonko Labs Engineering Assignment.pdf](</Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Downloads/Zonko Labs Engineering Assignment.pdf>) in your Downloads folder.

Is that the one you mean?

do you think it is completed? If yes, when did I completed the assignment and could you list what are the things that I've been doing extra because why not? If not, what are the things to complete ASAP

**The submission is not complete.** The local POC is substantial, but its delivery checklist still has unfinished items.

1. **Runnable repository:** setup documentation exists, but [SETUP.md:5](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/SETUP.md:5) explicitly says clean-machine browser activation needs verification. Read-only Git inspection found **no configured remote** and only one commit, `e322abeb`, dated **1 October 2026**, “Enable Entire session tracking.” Current implementation/docs are largely staged or untracked, so Git does not establish a completion date.

2. **Reviewer access:** [POC_SCOPE.md:7](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/POC_SCOPE.md:7) selects the MacBook-hosted POC and defers cloud hosting. [POC_SCOPE.md:30](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/POC_SCOPE.md:30) still lists Sahan/Nishank acceptance and closed-lid availability as pending. [SUBMISSION.md:19](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/SUBMISSION.md:19) says publication and reviewer contact await owner review. Do not require laptop-independent hosting: that belongs to superseded production scope.

3. **Approximately two-minute demo:** [README.md:16](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/README.md:16) and feature-demo rows at lines 27–30 remain placeholders. Movies/Downloads search found four October 10 payment-patch audit clips, but no identifiable final assignment demo. [SUBMISSION.md:10](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/SUBMISSION.md:10) specifies a real task, private access handoff, and independently checked result.

4. **Access-management note:** exists and is substantial: [ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.md](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.md). It explicitly marks real Indian card payments unverified at [line 67](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.md:67), and fresh merchant authentication acceptance separately limited at line 127.

5. **Reconcile stale documentation before submission:** `POC_SCOPE.md` still describes Browser Use/local Chromium; current [SETUP.md:98](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/SETUP.md:98) requires Kernel. README says zero benchmark runs, but newer [benchmark-rerun.md:5](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/decisions/2026-10-11-benchmark-rerun.md:5) carries six verified outcomes and documents continuing repairs. `SUBMISSION.md:15–17` contains older isolation/test warnings; do not present those as proven current vulnerabilities without checking current owning evidence.

**Scope exception:** [production/V1_SCOPE.md:19](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/production/V1_SCOPE.md:19) records that the user reported **Sahan approved Slack identity replacing Google-only chatbot sign-in**. A separate Google chatbot login is therefore not an ASAP blocker under that recorded approval. [Line 21](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/production/V1_SCOPE.md:21) explicitly identifies private DMs/shared channel context and reviewer separation as user-added v1 behavior beyond the assignment’s browser/access core.

**Core functionality caveat:** automatic TOTP is an assignment requirement, not an optional embellishment. [V1_SCOPE.md:132](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/production/V1_SCOPE.md:132) says manual code entry does not satisfy it. Latest [benchmark-rerun.md:7](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/decisions/2026-10-11-benchmark-rerun.md:7) correctly requires a fresh challenge with saved TOTP submitted without a person supplying the code; [line 13](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/decisions/2026-10-11-benchmark-rerun.md:13) says its first GitHub rerun never reached that challenge.

**Earliest defensible milestone:** **5 October 2026** was a documented functioning Slack browser/onboarding POC, per [POC_SCOPE.md:5](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/POC_SCOPE.md:5). It was not completed assignment delivery.
